description: PART B (2/2): Implement Test Magdalena Contreras (Lizarazo) as a fully interactive, self-scored DUAL-dimension method (Interés + Aptitud) in the existing registry, following the CHASIDE pattern. 10 work fields x 6 items in EACH of two parallel questionnaires (60 Interés + 60 Aptitud = 120 items), 0-4 scale, per-field max 24, with interpretation BANDS. Reuse/generalize the CHASIDE-style Interés-vs-Aptitud dual results panel. Depends on FEAT-002 only for shared touchpoints (types.ts MethodId union, registry, AdminClient, method-registry.test.ts) to avoid merge conflicts; implement after FEAT-002.
steps: Read skills/knowledge/test-magdalena-contreras.md for the authoritative structure: TWO parallel questionnaires — Intereses (60 items, 10 fields x 6) and Aptitudes (60 items, same 10 fields x 6) = 120 items total. The 10 fields are exactly: Servicio Social, Ejecutivo-Persuasivo, Verbal, Artístico-Plástica, Musical, Organización, Científica, Cálculo, Mecánico-Constructiva, Trabajo al Aire Libre. Scale is 0-4 for BOTH: Intereses labels 'Me gusta mucho'(4)..'Me desagrada mucho'(0); Aptitudes labels 'Muy competente'(4)..'Incompetente'(0). Each field max 24 pts per dimension. Interest bands: 0-6 Falta de Motivación, 7-12 Intereses Comunes, 13-18 Intereses Subprofesionales, 19-24 Intereses Profesionales. Aptitude bands: 0-6 Falta de Práctica, 7-12 Aptitudes Comunes, 13-18 Aptitudes Normales, 19-24 Aptitudes Desarrolladas.

Create web/lib/methods/magdalena/data.ts following chaside/data.ts (which uses category INTERES/APTITUD on questions): define the 10 field codes (e.g. SERVICIO_SOCIAL, EJECUTIVO_PERSUASIVO, VERBAL, ARTISTICO_PLASTICA, MUSICAL, ORGANIZACION, CIENTIFICA, CALCULO, MECANICO_CONSTRUCTIVA, AIRE_LIBRE), a canonical order array, a MAGDALENA_DIMENSIONS Record<code, MethodDimension> (Spanish titles + shortDesc from the doc's field descriptions + a color), and two ITEM records: INTERES (6 items per field) and APTITUD (6 items per field). Build MAGDALENA_QUESTIONS via buildQuestions() assigning correlative ids 1..120: for each field emit its 6 INTERES items (category 'INTERES') then its 6 APTITUD items (category 'APTITUD'), in canonical field order. Add the standard header comment disclosing the item wording is an original faithful adaptation (structure/scoring from the doc; not a licensable verbatim bank).

Create web/lib/methods/magdalena/engine.ts with a PURE scoreMagdalena(answers) following chaside/engine.ts: response value is the raw 0-4 for each item. Sum per field SEPARATELY for Interés and Aptitud (each field: 6 items x max 4 = max 24). Compute a normalized 0-100 per field dimension entry. Provide a helper that maps a 0-24 field score to its Interés band and Aptitud band label (Spanish, per the doc). dominantCodes = the fields with the highest Interés totals (top 3, canonical tie-break). Build a Spanish dominantSummary and interpretation that names dominant Interés fields, notes their Interés band, and highlights any Interés-vs-Aptitud mismatch (e.g. high interest but low aptitude in a field). Handle the all-zero/no-answers case with a neutral Spanish message. Expose raw with per-field interes and aptitud totals (and band labels) so the results view can render the dual comparison and JSON round-trips through method_scores JSONB.

Register Magdalena Contreras in web/lib/methods/registry.ts: extend MethodId in web/lib/methods/types.ts to include 'MAGDALENA'; add a MAGDALENA_SCALE ResponseScale — the 0-4 scale has 5 options, which exceeds the current ResponseScale.kind union (LIKERT_5|LIKERT_3|DICHOTOMOUS). Add a new kind value 'LIKERT_0_4' (a 5-point 0..4 scale) to the ResponseScale.kind union in types.ts and use it; the AssessmentClient renders options generically from scale.options so no client change is required beyond the union. Provide Spanish option labels for the 5 points (use the Interés wording as the primary labels, e.g. 'Me desagrada mucho'(0) .. 'Me gusta mucho'(4); the results view distinguishes Interés vs Aptitud). Build MAGDALENA_METHOD VocationalMethod (id 'MAGDALENA', Spanish name 'Test Magdalena Contreras', shortDescription + origin from the doc: Alcaldía La Magdalena Contreras 2021 / Lizarazo 2024, dual Interés+Aptitud over 10 campos), add to METHODS, and add 'MAGDALENA' to normalizeMethodId accepted ids.

Add Magdalena to the cohort method dropdown: add { id: 'MAGDALENA', name: 'Test Magdalena Contreras' } to METHOD_OPTIONS in web/components/AdminClient.tsx (the /assessment selector picks it up automatically from listMethods).

Reuse the dual Interés-vs-Aptitud results panel: in web/app/results/[sessionId]/page.tsx, generalize the CHASIDE-only ChasideInteresAptitud so it also renders for MAGDALENA. Because Magdalena's per-field maxima are 24 for BOTH Interés and Aptitud (unlike CHASIDE's 10/4), make the panel read the maxima from method_scores.raw (or branch on methodId) rather than hardcoding CHASIDE_INTERES_MAX/CHASIDE_APTITUD_MAX. Render it when session.methodId is 'CHASIDE' OR 'MAGDALENA', pulling per-field interes/aptitud totals from raw. For MAGDALENA also surface the band label per field where practical. Keep CHASIDE's existing behavior and numbers unchanged.

Add real (non-stub) Vitest tests web/tests/magdalena-engine.test.ts following chaside-engine.test.ts: assert 120 items with unique ids 1..120; assert 10 fields each with 6 INTERES + 6 APTITUD; assert scoreMagdalena sums Interés and Aptitud per field separately (max 24 each) for a crafted set; assert the band mapping (e.g. 24 -> 'Intereses Profesionales' / 'Aptitudes Desarrolladas', 6 -> 'Falta de Motivación' / 'Falta de Práctica', boundary cases 6/7, 12/13, 18/19); assert dominantCodes picks highest-Interés fields; assert the Interés-vs-Aptitud mismatch is reflected in raw; assert the neutral empty-set message; assert raw JSON round-trip.

Update web/tests/method-registry.test.ts again: sorted ids array now includes 'MAGDALENA'; METHODS.MAGDALENA defined; normalizeMethodId('magdalena')==='MAGDALENA'; getMethod('MAGDALENA').questions has length 120.

Update web/README.md (Spanish): add Test Magdalena Contreras to the seleccionable-methods table (120 items = 60 Interés + 60 Aptitud; 10 campos x 6; scale 0-4; per-field max 24; interpretation bands; dual Interés-vs-Aptitud display like CHASIDE) and move it OUT of the 'material de referencia' list into the interactive list. Update the reference/future section so neither CIP-R nor Magdalena Contreras remain listed as deferred, keeping the adaptation-disclosure note for both new banks.
acceptance_criteria: getMethod('MAGDALENA').questions has exactly 120 items with unique ids 1..120, split 60 INTERES + 60 APTITUD across 10 fields (6 each per dimension).

scoreMagdalena computes per-field Interés and Aptitud totals separately (each max 24), maps them to the correct Spanish bands at the documented cut points, selects dominant Interés fields, and returns a Spanish interpretation; the empty case returns a neutral Spanish message.
The /results view renders a dual Interés-vs-Aptitud panel for MAGDALENA (using field maxima of 24) and CHASIDE's existing panel/numbers are unchanged.
Test Magdalena Contreras appears in the /assessment selector and cohort dropdown and a methodId 'MAGDALENA' session scores/persists through the generic sessions branch.
web/tests/magdalena-engine.test.ts and the updated method-registry test pass; the new ResponseScale kind 'LIKERT_0_4' typechecks and renders (5 buttons) in AssessmentClient.
web/README.md lists Magdalena Contreras (and CIP-R) as interactive methods; neither remains in the deferred list.
typecheck, lint, vitest --run, and the no-env build all pass from web/.
verification: From web/ (after sourcing nvm): npm run typecheck
npx vitest --run  (magdalena-engine + updated method-registry tests pass; all prior tests still pass)
env -u DATABASE_URL -u AI_API_KEY npm run build
